title: Prohibited-Claims Register — Historical Baseline (P-1..P-40) v1
description: The owner-ratified 40-entry historical baseline of the certificate-compiler prohibited-claims register (P-1 through P-40, catalog `cat.cert.prohibited.baseline.v0`), transcribed verbatim from the 'Prohibited sentence form' column of runs/response-comparison-debugging/prohibited-register-P1-P40-DRAFT.md (owner ratification decision A, 2026-09-07). This document is the CANONICAL BASELINE ONLY — it does not include the two already-merged Wave-C addition tables (WAVE_C_C6_C1_ADDITIONS, WAVE_C_C2_C5_ADDITIONS) that TraigentBackend's prohibited_claims.py ships alongside this baseline; those remain owned by TraigentBackend. Closed shape: exactly 40 entries, no additional properties anywhere. The document is content-addressed by a separate sibling pin file (prohibited_register_baseline.digest.json) rather than a self-embedded digest field.
